name: Mangal Compusolution Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2012, Mangal Compusolution 
Ltd deals in IT hardware solutions and Rental services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
MCL is in the business of IT services. It provides customized solutions for various hardware and software rental needs. Company offers desktop, laptops or any presentation equipment for short and long-term business requirements, and also provides Pre-Configured and Tested machines including Add-ons like laser printers, large screen monitors, LCD Projectors. It also provides on-site support and maintenance services Company has repaired ~1280 laptops, ~848 computers, and has installed ~450 Operating Systems

pros: Debtor days have improved from 122 to 96.8 days.
cons: Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.82 Cr.
